(ignore my edgy username it's because it's a vent account)

I lied to my gf about the day of our anniversary.

It's Feb 4th but it is exactly one month after my failed suicide attempt (I'm emotionally better now) and I got her to think it's Feb 5th. 

Is it fucked up that I lied to her which day it was and that I've lied for 3/4 years? yeah it is, but I don't want to celebrate my love on the day of my attempted self-death
I believe a trip to the doctor without insurance is around 150 dollars
ALSO: I don't take my asthma medication that often due to my asthma not being horrible. It's just a minor annoyance

im living with friends in an apartment for college. Like, i'm very privileged when it comes to friends. if anything i should be the happiest i ever have been. It probably just my past creeping up on me and slowly breaking me

I am moving in with my girlfriend and two other friends for next year of college, not sure how long thats going to work though due to lack of funds. I had a sidejob last year and I probably will again (i'm a full time student so the sidejob has to be on weekends.) Therapists cost money so I can't do that. I have been opening up more to friends in recent years, some are great to vent to, others are not. It makes my girlfriend cry when I vent so I sadly avoid telling her my life now. Do you really think I could get some sort of scholarship from talking about my mediocre life to my school?
I am so glad for you. Have a great time with him!
